observations: Parallel conversion clears camera up and direction locks before the already-parallel/symmetry early return; location lock remains.
Symmetric-frustum conversion changes requested left/right and top/bottom fields first, invalidates projection content for each changed axis, and can dolly the camera using the target plane distance.
The symmetric-frustum result is not checked by ChangeToParallelProjection before setting symmetry flags. Preserve original mutation/return ordering.
TargetDistance can fall back to the frustum midpoint only with valid camera/frustum and the requested fallback policy; an invalid/behind-camera target is handled separately.
Perspective-to-parallel rescales left/right/bottom/top by targetDistance/near when prerequisites hold; near/far are preserved through SetFrustum.
Target recentering requires valid camera/frustum and positive valid distance; movement below 1e-5*(width+height)+ON_ZERO_TOLERANCE is retained to avoid visible numeric jitter.
SetProjection changes the projection enum without an explicit projection-content invalidation in this published method; unknown enum falls back to parallel and returns false.
SetTargetPoint accepts valid point or the full unset point and otherwise retains previous target; its validation does not apply camera-location world bounds.
requiredProof: Joint raw camera/frame/frustum/projection/target state with cumulative invalidation/diagnostics after each operation; preserve all existing numerical helpers.

Compile unchanged source transitions and exact point/vector helpers, exercising already-parallel, all symmetry/validity/locks, off-axis target/dolly, unset/behind/huge target, asymmetric fields and failed setters.
Connect source preset order/lens/projection to double world-frame composition and normalized uploaded mesh without inventing source default framing.
Capture actual source preset Metal output on iPad/iPhone and keep original private Rhino5/PC/physical comparisons separate.
limits: No transition implementation or runtime comparison is asserted by this audit.
